builds.name: ai-1 keep it nominal
builds.rationale: IPC-nominal land patterns everywhere and the manufacturer pattern for the flash: the safest choice for reflow assembly.

builds.name: ai-2 thermal vias under the RP2040
builds.rationale: Use KiCad's thermal-via QFN footprint so the exposed pad can dump heat into the inner planes.
reasons: Every drilled hole is at least 8 mil: U1: drill below 8 mil

builds.name: ai-3 hand-solder the big passives
builds.rationale: The 0603 and 0805 parts are the ones a person would rework by hand, so give only those the longer hand-solder pads.

builds.name: ai-4 wider SOIC for the flash
builds.rationale: KiCad's 5.275 mm SOIC-8 footprint also targets 208 mil bodies and has slightly longer pads.

builds.name: ai-5 hand-solder the crystal
builds.rationale: The 3225 crystal has pads under the body; the hand-solder footprint exposes them for an iron.

builds.name: ai-6 hand-solder LEDs and regulator
builds.rationale: LEDs are polarised and often replaced, and the regulator is the hottest part; longer pads make both easier to rework.
